items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I'm probably. He's not brown-skinned. I heard that name.

ctx.x: Oh no, those men were superior to me 100%. They don't come to a better than them kind men when he was at his prime, you know. I don't know who you take Piku.

You know who Mr. Lopat used to play something like that? He used to play something like Mealy. On that order, Mealy Barnes. But just like Mealy, you know. He had eyesight, he had eyesight. But when I heard him play, that's what all he played. You know Mealy Barnes? Do you know him? I'm probably. He's not brown-skinned. He's not brown-skinned. He's not. I heard that name. Well he used to play with Chris Kelly and all those guys, but he was not steady with those guys. He played with them and all. He played with…

Yeah, but Chris when he came there most of the time he was with Ellis. My mother's great. He's come out there most of the time he was with Ellis. My mother's great. Chris Kelly? I didn't know they played together. He's come out there most of the time he was with Ellis.
